# Rhizopedia - 3D Wikipedia Explorer

## Project Overview
A Three.js-based 3D visualization game that displays Wikipedia articles as floating 3D text. The main article title is centered, with linked articles arranged in a circle around it with dynamic spacing to prevent overlap.

## Technology Stack
- Three.js for 3D rendering
- Vite for development and build tooling
- Wikipedia API for fetching articles and links
- Vanilla JavaScript (ES modules)

## Key Features
- Fetch random Wikipedia articles via API
- Parse article body to extract linked articles
- Render article titles as 3D text in space
- Dynamic circular layout with collision detection
- Interactive 3D camera controls

## Development Guidelines
- Use modern ES6+ JavaScript
- Keep modules focused and single-purpose
- Use Three.js best practices for performance
- Handle Wikipedia API errors gracefully
